Houston, remember Martin Payne from the show "Martin"? He's back, live, and better than ever. Martin Lawrence is bringing his signature energy and sharp observations to the stage. Known for his physical comedy and engaging stories, he's a must-see. Lawrence has recently gone viral for his impressive transformation, showing up healthier and ready to entertain.  

Smart Financial Centre at Sugar Land · Friday, May 29, 2026

Remember Tim Meadows from *Saturday Night Live*? Houston, he's bringing his versatile and character-driven comedy to our stage. Known for his spot-on impersonations and sharp satire, Tim's live shows are a masterclass in improvisation. You might know him as Leon Phelps or Principal Ron Duvall, but wait until you see him live. His humor is as fresh as ever.
